items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Poor Santo, when we were playing with Sharky, you know, we made up to five hundred dollars a week with Sharky.

ctx.x: He certainly... It was a tragedy that he had to stop playing. That was awful. See, I never got to hear him at all. Oh, he was just great.

Just great. Beautiful tone out of a horn. Mm-hmm. He got a tone. He played sort of like Sharky did. All those years... Well, I would say that Sharky and Dick both almost grew up together. You would saw practically. Except Dick was from a very fine family.
